decisions.reason: Permitting shorter clip styles does not change which source videos or B-roll may be used.
Clip duration and style length do not alter the requirement to remove distracting wind noise.
The source permits shorter clip styles but does not change caption color, font, effects, lettering, or position.
Shorter clip styles remain compatible with the existing clean and simple editing constraints.
The source does not relax the requirement that each clip deliver a complete, understandable teaching moment.
Permitting shorter styles does not necessarily change the standard for selecting strong or impactful moments.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY recording mastery of the shorter-format approach as an advancement prerequisite; no correction is required.
Shorter styles may make the quota easier to reach, but they do not change the 100-approved-clips quota or its counting rule.
The source changes an allowed clip style, not the client's approval authority or the requirement that clips be approved before counting or publication.
The qualification process was already completed, and the new production style does not alter that historical completion state.
Permitting shorter clip styles does not change which clips may be published, their destination, or the existing publication authorization.
The source does not change the submission channel, folder requirements, batch size, deadline, or review workflow.
